dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a sharp gradient from the dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey high-contrast perimeter. The most prominent annuli on the mid-posterior flank show thin, jagged light-intensity boundaries with dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid light-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily along the lower mid-lateral and ventral-lateral boundary transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest posterior-flank annuli form an obtuse triangle; a secondary cluster of four annuli on the mid-lateral section forms an irregular trapezoidal relationship.
